about: The Pune demo as the engine answers it, for the boards of Phase 7 (plan/phase-07-plan.md, step 0). Written by the session with rooftop_api; the boards are written again from this file without the engine. The custom option's refusal and the Voc coefficient entered are computed here as the plan decides them (decisions 6 and 8), before the API has them.
